jobs.prompt: Photograph of the Rocky Mountain front range at deep blue hour, seen from the plains near Denver, Colorado, autumn 2009. Dark layered mountain silhouettes, a thin band of fading cold light along the ridge line, a few faint distant lights in the foothills, a dark sky with a subtle gradient. Calm, quiet, wide, ordinary stock photo used as a computer wallpaper, low contrast, mostly dark, muted blue-grey colours, no stars, no moon. No people, no buildings in focus, no text, no logos, no watermark.
